threads.name: The treasure map
threads.note: The party is following a map whose marked locations they don't recognize, and the treasure has not been found.

threads.name: The Brandonsford dragon
threads.note: Eric the Reeve's 1000-gold bounty for killing the black dragon and dragging its body to town is open, with leads from George, Farmer Gill's history and Gill's sons already hunting it.

threads.name: The Clurichen
threads.note: Reginald warns of a trickster creature that comes into town from the riverbanks every night; the danger stands on its own and is unexplored.

threads.name: Lady Hilda's offer to join the hunt
threads.note: Lady Hilda would join the dragon hunt for money, and Sir Phidipaldi said they would return to hire her after talking to the Reeve; its stated purpose is the dragon hunt.

threads.name: Brandonsford's missing shipments
threads.note: Bentley's restock shipment is a week overdue and Gill says nothing has come into town in months; why is unknown.

threads.name: Drop Dead Ned's offer
threads.note: Ned offered himself and his killer wasp for hire and Dr. Uriah said he'd think about it, so the offer remains available.

threads.name: Shamus the mule
threads.note: Farmer Gill offered the mule for 100 gold or work like killing the dragon, and Dunk is thinking it over.

threads.name: Quinn's fake shipment scheme
threads.note: Sir Phidipaldi agreed to Quinn's 100-gold plan to stage a fake ale delivery to catch whoever empties his bar at night, which Quinn blames on Bentley; it has not yet happened.
